guard_snippet: if (item.complete_state <= 0) return ''; // or use safe default
potential_consequence: Division by zero or Infinity percentage shown to screen reader
Percentage over 100% announced; semantically incorrect progress

trigger_condition: items array becomes empty after having items
guard_snippet: Track removed items and announce departure or clear announcement
potential_consequence: No announcer for rows removed from table; silent deletion not confirmed to screen reader

trigger_condition: repo_name is null, undefined, or empty string
potential_consequence: Announcement reads ': Completed' without source identification

trigger_condition: isInProgress true but getDataSourceStatusInfo not called for percentage condition
guard_snippet: Ensure getDataSourceStatusInfo runs before percentage check or memoize result
potential_consequence: Stale isInProgress flag if getDataSourceStatusInfo has side effects or timing issues

trigger_condition: component unmounts while items still updating
potential_consequence: previousRef persists across remounts; re-announcement logic breaks on second mount

trigger_condition: announce called with whitespace-only or control characters
potential_consequence: Screen reader receives empty or whitespace announcement; no audible notification

trigger_condition: Item has error=true AND is_fetching=true simultaneously
guard_snippet: Add explicit priority: error takes precedence (e.g., check error first)
potential_consequence: Ambiguous status announcement; 'Fetching' announced instead of 'Error'

trigger_condition: Item has completed=true AND is_queued=true simultaneously
guard_snippet: Enforce invariant: completed and is_queued are mutually exclusive
potential_consequence: isQueued check passes despite completed; wrong status announced

trigger_condition: indexStatuses undefined or null instead of array
guard_snippet: const items = indexStatuses ?? [] in hook call
potential_consequence: forEach fails on null/undefined; hook crashes, no announcements fire

trigger_condition: getIndexesStatuses store fetch fails, no error boundary
guard_snippet: Wrap hook or fetch in try-catch; announce error state
potential_consequence: Failed fetch leaves stale indexStatuses; misleading old announcements replay

trigger_condition: items array order changes but content identical
guard_snippet: Treat as no-change since Map keys are item.id, not position
potential_consequence: Correct: no re-announcement on reorder. Implicit path verified.

trigger_condition: Multiple rows change status between renders; only first announced if announce is sync
guard_snippet: Verify useAnnouncementQueue queues all calls before render
potential_consequence: If announce is async or debounced, middle updates lost in burst

guard_snippet: Add guard: if (!INDEX_TYPES.PROVIDER) treat as non-provider
potential_consequence: Type equality check fails silently; percentage shown for provider progress

trigger_condition: Percentage calculation result is NaN (e.g., 0/0 case edge)
potential_consequence: Announcement contains 'NaN%' literal string to screen reader
